name: Amanjiwo
positioning: Aman resort in the rural heartland of Central Java, overlooking the Borobudur temple
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet, rural base overlooking Borobudur
Guests interested in temple visits and Javanese culture

facts.text: Amanjiwo is in the rural heartland of Central Java, surrounded by rainforest, hills and rice paddies.
The resort overlooks the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Borobudur, one of Buddhism's most sacred Mahayana temples.
The resort lies at the foot of the Menoreh Hills and cascades down the hillside from a rotunda to a swimming pool.
Amanjiwo is named 'peaceful soul' for the serenity, privacy and beauty of its setting.
Aman offers a Journey through Java by Train experience that ends with arrival at Amanjiwo after a seven-hour train journey.
The Ancient Temples experience at Borobudur includes temple guides who explain the knowledge contained in the stone reliefs.
At Borobudur, as the morning mist lifts, the surrounding volcanoes and terraced fields come into view.
Amanjiwo is placed for exploring the region's historic, artistic and cultural highlights.
Guests can combine stays at Aman's four Indonesian resorts and choose exclusive experiences at each.
Condé Nast Traveler lists Amanjiwo at Jalan Salaman-mungkid, Magelang, Java.
